# Cirth v0.6.0

Cirth v0.6.0 adds RTL support, fixes seventeen bugs surfaced by an
audit of every open issue on upstream picocss/pico, and rebuilds the
docs site on Astro. No breaking changes to the published CSS.

## Highlights

- **RTL support.** Every physical direction property in `src/`
  (margins, padding, borders, insets, corner radii, `text-align`) now
  uses the logical equivalent. Properties with no logical form inside
  the Browserslist floor — `float`, directional `background-position`,
  a `translateX` — mirror under `[dir="rtl"]` instead. LTR rendering
  is pixel-identical, verified against the full 164-shot visual
  regression suite.
- **17 bugs fixed**, each re-verified live against this fork's own
  source before fixing (several upstream reports no longer applied,
  or applied differently than described): table cells painting the
  page background inside cards, a dead CSS custom property, five more
  RTL-specific bugs (blockquote border, breadcrumb divider, modal,
  dropdown, group corner rounding), the loading spinner — now colored
  via a `currentColor` mask so it adapts to every button variant and
  color scheme instead of a baked-in stroke color, and now visible on
  `<input type="submit">` — plus card/grid/group spacing fixes and a
  respected `img[height]` attribute. Full list in the
  [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#060---2026-08-02).
- **Docs site rebuilt on Astro**, replacing VitePress. Same content,
  same "carta e incisione" branding, same dogfooded CSS shell — but
  the site now ships near-zero client JS: the only two interactive
  bits (the theme toggle, the homepage's typing demo) are plain
  `<script>` tags, not a client framework.

## Fixed

See the [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#060---2026-08-02)
for the complete, itemized list of fixes and their upstream issue
references.
